summary: The filing reports the consummation of Disciplined Growth Acquisition Corporation's initial public offering of 15,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, generating $150 million in gross proceeds. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one right to receive one-fourth of a share upon a future business combination. The net proceeds were deposited into a trust account. This is a routine IPO closing filing for a SPAC, not a special situation; the SPAC has not yet announced or completed a business combination.
